description: Free. Link for whoever holds the company's e-CNPJ (owner, accountant): give challenge_id and the agent's signature, get the /sign URL. They see agent, company and mandate and sign in the browser (A1 .pfx) or with any ICP-Brasil signer (A3 token, cloud), or run kya-sign (npm @kya-brasil/agent-tools) with the link. The issuer never sees the certificate.

agent_signature.description: The agent's signature of challenge.text, so the person only signs with the e-CNPJ.

name: kya_sign_link
